integrity: Analytic exact-sequence proof; no experiments, external computational certificates, or unsupported independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion assumes an infinite countable bounded-geometry metric space with a bounded-step simple ray. The K-theory result is relative to K-groups of the full uniform Roe algebra and its K1 section depends on a chosen ray. Nuclear dimension uses the stated 13 November 2026 preprint of Guo, Li, Zhang and Zhu as a prior theorem; no independent validation of that paper or exhaustive bibliographic uniqueness is asserted.
title: Coarse-ray index splitting and exact nuclear dimension of uniform Roe coronas
